en: A sepia-toned historical postcard depicting a tram station in front of a large building. In the foreground, vintage trams are lined up on the tracks. In the background, there are notable landmarks: a tall, pointed tower, a round tower, and residences set against a mountainous backdrop. The caption in Italian at the top right reads 'Trento - Stazione del Tram.'
